summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Sistema TRAIN dashboard. All required features working perfectly including split-screen auth, dashboard with AI sidebar, three main tabs, and chart visualizations.

minor_issues.issue: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1
minor_issues.impact: Charts render correctly but show console warnings
minor_issues.symptoms: Console logs show 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'

passed_tests: Landing page loads with minimal, clean design
Auth page displays perfect split-screen layout (form left, blue gradient right)
User registration form works without errors
User login successfully redirects to dashboard
Dashboard shows left sidebar with AI chat functionality
Dashboard displays all three required tabs: Datos, Periodizar, Plan-gráfico
Periodizar tab shows both line chart (Planificación Anual) and radar chart (Perfil de Rendimiento)
Datos tab shows expandable navigation with 16 clickable sections
Chat input accepts messages and shows AI responses
Form inputs in dashboard header work correctly
User profile section displays with logout functionality
Statistics cards show proper metrics (Atletas, Planes, Sesiones, IA Usadas)
